Name: Clown Husbandry
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
Clown husbandry is a time honoured tradition, and now you can partake in it too!

[size=3][b]Obtaining Your Very Own Clown[/b][/size]

Clowns need a large roaming space to thrive, so make sure you have a deluxe barn before buying a clown from Marnie's.

There are many different varieties of clowns, and Marnie sells 3 different variations.

[size=3][b]Clown Care[/b][/size]

Clowns produce clown eggs every three days. Very happy clowns may produce jack in the boxes - special boxes that can be opened at Clint's to give you fun surprises. Clown scarecrows, dolls, and noses are just some of the prizes you can win! Happy clowns may also produce every two days instead of three, so make sure to take good care of your clown!

[size=3][b]Clown Produce[/b][/size]

Clown Egg - Can be placed in an Ostrich Incubator to hatch new clowns or eaten for special buffs! Eating a clown egg will increase friendship gain from talking to other people while the buff is active and provide a short +2 speed buff.

Jack In The Box - Produced by happy clowns. When opened by Clint it gives a wide variety of items, including some new ones introduced by this mod!



*Although clowns resemble humans in many ways, clowns are actually more closely related to fungi. Resemblance to humans is due to convergent evolution and not shared ancestry.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Clown Husbandy
Manifest.Description: Adds a few clowns that are farmable.
